payload.title: RM W3 The cloud in lessons: CloudProvider, compile harness, differential spec, c1/10-11
payload.description: Real-machine plan (docs/real-machine-curriculum.md section 6). Each wave ships alone and ends with lessons on the path. Contents: CloudProvider; compile harness with recorded answers; Source (read-only), Program rows with captions, cloud terminal; pre-warm and fallback; the differential spec; c1/10-11. Riskiest assumption: the cold start is hidden by pre-warm, and 'the compiler wrote my cards' is a wow, not a shrug. Guardian playtest question: Time from Compile to result, and her words when the words match.
